questions.question: What is the multiplicative model in time series analysis? / a). A model where components are multiplied b). A model where components are added together c). A model that assumes no trend d). A model that ignores seasonality
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (a) A model where components are multiplied
questions.final_answer: Option A model where components are multiplied

questions.question: What is the main objective of time series analysis? / a). To find relationships between two variables b). To forecast future values based on past data c). To compare multiple datasets d). None of the above
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (b) To forecast future values based on past data
questions.final_answer: Option (b) To forecast future values based on past data

questions.question: What does stationarity in a time series imply? / a). The mean and variance of the series change over time b). The statistical properties remain constant over time c). The series is always increasing d). The time series contains no noise
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (b) The statistical properties remain constant over time
questions.final_answer: Option (b) The statistical properties remain constant over time

questions.question: Why is white noise assumed in residual analysis of time series models? / a). To remove random fluctuations b). To simplify trend detection c). To confirm that no additional patterns remain in the data d). To make seasonality analysis unnecessary
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (c) To confirm that no additional patterns remain in the data
questions.final_answer: Option (c) To confirm that no additional patterns remain in the data
